newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica 1996 banana exports fall 5.3 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica 1996 banana exports fall 5.3 pct in '96.

text.p: Costa Rica's banana exports fell 5.3 percent in 1996 to 106.4 million boxes from 112 million boxes in 1995, banana industry officials said Thursday.
Each box of one of Costa Rica's most important exports is equivalent to 18.14 kilograms.

"One of the most influencing factors in the fall in sales were the floods that affected the Caribbean shore last year," manager of the National Banana Corporation (Corbana) Jorge Sauma told reporters.
A Corbana investigations director, Ronald Vargas, said import restrictions from the European Union and the nation's economic crisis also hurt banana exports.
